label: Vietnam's textured protein exports (HS 2106.10)
context: Against about USD 34 million of imports of the same code (supply study TF-002) and USD 380 million of Chinese exports in 2024: Vietnam has no protein-ingredient export base yet.

label: EU tariff margin for Vietnamese plant-based food lines over Thailand and China
context: EVFTA gives 0% on textured protein (MFN 12.8%), food preparations (9% plus EA), plant drinks (9.6%, from 1 January 2025) and prepared nuts (7 to 10.2%); Thailand and China pay MFN.

label: US plant-based meat and seafood retail sales
context: Down 10% in value and 11% in units in 2025, and 17% in value since 2023; the main Western market for analogues is shrinking.

label: Plant-based food sales in six large European markets
context: Up 3.3% in value and 4.8% in volume; growth where prices fell and in private label, milk, yoghurt and tofu, tempeh and seitan.

label: German plant-based seafood retail sales
context: Down 22% in value and 29% in volume; plant-based seafood is the weakest category, a warning for plant-based seafood export plans.

label: US additional Section 301 tariff on Vietnamese goods
context: Versus 10% for Malaysia, Indonesia and India and 12.5% for Thailand; cashews and coconuts exempt; plant-based foods not exempt.

label: Vietnamese feed mills in the ASC programme
context: ASC Feed Standard requires deforestation-free soy commitments, marine sourcing improvement and per-tonne GHG reporting: the main export-linked pull for traceable, low-footprint feed protein.

label: Vietnam's cashew exports
context: 766,585 t; China 21.3%, US 18.6%, Netherlands 9.5%: the plant-based dairy platform with the widest reach.
